I am a machine learning engineer working on applied ML, computer vision, and the software systems around them. I currently work at Meta, and previously worked on ML and computer vision for autonomous retail systems.

I use this site for projects and notes around AI research, retrieval, media tooling, and software as a medium.
:::
:::

## Interests

- Machine learning systems and computer vision for real-world products.
- Search, retrieval, and code-understanding tools for working with large information spaces.
- Media interfaces that make images, video, and text easier to explore.
- Writing about AI research, engineering practice, and software as a creative material.
